title: Calma, Professor! VR — a classroom game made with Codex and Claude (Portuguese animated promo)
author: Typical-Instance-376
selftext:
I'm Samuel, a teacher and the creator of Calma, Professor! VR, a classroom game I developed with Codex and Claude.



The project's credits reflect a mixed asset pipeline: scenery, objects and illustrations made with ChatGPT and Hunyuan 3D, then finished in Blender; Kenney characters and sounds; synthesized voices.



The core idea comes from a classroom situation: everyone wants help at once. You help students in arrival order and keep a combo going. For a VR interaction like this, how would you make the next student's priority clear without covering the scene with UI?



This 20-second Portuguese clip is an animated promotional interpretation of that idea, not recorded gameplay. The cover was created with AI support from my real photo.



Explore the game for Meta Quest; the page also offers a no-headset screen test:

[https://quantaaulas.com/calma-professor-teste/](https://quantaaulas.com/calma-professor-teste/)



For the longer how-to video showing the game:
